verdict.rationale: Fellow documents webhooks and a REST API, but these are developer building blocks: the integrator supplies the receiving endpoint and all action logic. The evidence explicitly states no in-product rules engine or trigger-action configuration is documented. Automatic meeting summaries are core product behavior, not user-configured background automations, so the story is unsupported.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
